questions.topic: Asking for the main idea

stimulus.body: L'extrait ci-dessous sert à vérifier la compréhension de cette forme. Parmi les quatre réponses, une seule s'appuie sur le texte lui-même.

questions.stem: Parmi les affirmations sur cette forme que propose l'extrait précédent, laquelle est la seule que le texte permette de retenir ?

options.text: The chart mainly shows that Marseille consistently drinks more coffee than Lyon.
options.misconception: confuses a side detail with the overall trend

options.text: The chart mainly shows a steady rise in coffee drinking in both cities over time.
The chart mainly shows that coffee prices fell sharply during the period.
options.misconception: imports a claim about price that the graph never makes

options.text: The chart mainly shows that Lyon stopped drinking coffee after 2020.
options.misconception: overreads a single low bar as a total disappearance

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: the bars rise in both cities, so the main idea is a shared upward trend. On that basis "The chart mainly shows a steady rise in coffee drinking in both cities over time" is the supported choice. Option A ("The chart mainly shows that Marseille consistently drinks more…") fails because it confuses a side detail with the overall trend; Option C ("The chart mainly shows that coffee prices fell sharply during…") fails because it imports a claim about price that the graph never makes; Option D ("The chart mainly shows that Lyon stopped drinking coffee after…") fails because it overreads a single low bar as a total disappearance.
questions.hint: Look at the direction of both sets of bars.
